examples.arabic: أمهم كانت تعد الفطور لهم كل يوم.
examples.english: Their mother used to prepare breakfast for them every day.
examples.transliteration: Ummuhum kanat tu'iddu al-futura lahum kulla yawm.
examples.storyTitle: A Day in the Life of Layla and Ali

examples.arabic: يا خالد، هل يمكنك مساعدتي في اختيار وجبة سريعة من تطبيق "كرم الشام"، حيث أنني كمعلمة لغة عربية مرهقة جداً من تصحيح الامتحانات في شقتنا بحي الدقي في هذا اليوم الممطر؟
examples.english: O Khalid, can you help me choose a fast meal from the "Karam Al-Sham" application, since I as an Arabic language teacher am very exhausted from grading the exams in our Al-Dokki neighborhood apartment on this rainy day?
examples.transliteration: Ya Khalid, hal yumkinuka musa'adati fi ikhtiyar wajba sari'a min tatbiq "Karam Al-Sham", haythu annani kumu'allimat lugha 'arabiyya murhaqa jiddan min tashih al-imtihanat fi shaqqatina bihayy Al-Duqqi fi hadha al-yawm al-mumtir?
examples.storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

examples.arabic: كان لكل منهما قواعده الخاصة في التحضير لهذا اليوم
examples.english: Each of them had their own rules for preparing for this day.
examples.transliteration: Kana li-kull minhuma qawa'iduhu al-khassa fi al-tahdir li-hadha al-yawm

examples.arabic: بعد شهور من الجهد والاجتماعات المكثفة اقترب موعد اليوم المنتظر بفارغ الصبر
examples.english: After months of intense effort and meetings, the eagerly awaited day approached.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da shuhour min al-juhd wal-ijtima'at al-mukaththafah iqtaraba maw'id al-yawm al-muntazar bi-farigh al-sabr.

examples.english: I wake up early every day.

examples.arabic: أنا أحب قضاء الوقت مع عائلتي كل يوم
examples.english: I love spending time with my family every day
examples.transliteration: Ana uhibbu qada'a al-waqti ma'a 'ailati kull yawmin
